QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_46

question.text: Generally, AIF fund reporting templates to LPs include all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Economy-specific details (GDP growth, fiscal position, currency and interest-rate outlook).
Current investment portfolio and allocation by the Fund, with break-up by company and sector.
Future outlook and deal pipeline during the investing period.
The personal trading positions held by the Fund Manager in his own demat account.

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 288 of XIX-D lists standard LP reporting content including economy-specific details, the current investment portfolio and allocation, future outlook and the deal pipeline. Options A, B and C all map directly to that list, so each is clearly part of the templates. The Trap: The Fund Manager's personal demat holdings are not listed among the LP reporting template items on page 288, which is why option D is the exception. Note: The pages checked do not extend the LP reporting template to personal demat positions, an insider-trading regime, or a specific quarterly deck structure; the answer rests purely on what page 288 lists.
